title: Full Visual Overhaul: Environment, Characters, and UI

requirements.summary: Overhaul 3D game environment with Islamic architecture, desert skybox with crescent moon, bazaar props, and seamless tiling
acceptanceCriteria: Minarets, domes, and arched structures are visible along the track as the player runs
Floor tiles display Islamic geometric patterns with warm sand/terracotta/teal colours
Sky renders as a warm desert gradient with a visible crescent moon and stars
Bazaar props (lanterns, market stalls) appear as side scenery
Environment tiles loop seamlessly with no visible seams or gaps

file_operations.description: Replace basic ground plane geometry with Islamic geometric patterned floor tiles using planeGeometry with detailed texture mapping (warm sand/terracotta/teal colors). Add multi-tiered minaret meshes with ornate cylindrical tops and pointed caps, domed mosque structures with ribbed sphereGeometry surfaces, and pointed arched doorways using combined box and cylinder geometries with geometric lattice details. Position these architectural elements along the track segments to appear as the player runs. Create bazaar market stall props (awnings using plane meshes, hanging lanterns using sphere + cylinder, decorative rugs using textured planes) and place them as side scenery. Implement seamless environment segment tiling by ensuring all architectural props reset and reposition smoothly as segments recycle in the infinite scroll system.

Replace basic skybox color with a layered desert gradient skybox: create a large sphereGeometry sky dome with a custom shader material or gradient texture mapping deep orange-amber at the horizon transitioning to deep teal-indigo at the zenith. Add a large visible crescent moon mesh (torusGeometry with one side removed or custom shape) positioned in the upper sky quadrant with an emissive gold material. Add multiple small star meshes (sphereGeometry with emissive white material) scattered across the sky dome to create a night desert sky atmosphere.

requirements.summary: Upgrade player character 3D models with detailed geometry, culturally appropriate headwear, colored clothing with folds, and idle/run animation
acceptanceCriteria: Each character has a distinct, recognisable silhouette with appropriate headwear shape
Clothing colours match each character's defined colour metadata
Characters visibly bob/animate while running
Character models look polished and culturally appropriate in the character select screen preview and in-game

file_operations.description: Enhance the player character mesh construction in the PlayerCharacter component to include more detailed geometry: add a stylised rounded head using sphereGeometry with distinguishable facial features (nose bump, eye indents using smaller spheres), properly shaped culturally appropriate headwear based on character type (kufi as rounded cap using sphereGeometry, hijab as draped cloth using planeGeometry wrapping over shoulders, full turban as wrapped cylindrical layers using multiple torusGeometry rings), and colored clothing (thobe/abaya/robe using cylindrical body mesh with boxGeometry sleeves) with visible fabric folds created via displaced vertices or layered geometry. Apply emissive or MeshStandardMaterial with the character's defined color metadata. Implement idle/run animation by adding a continuous vertical position bobbing effect (sine wave oscillation) and subtle rotation/tilt to simulate movement while running.

Ensure each CharacterDef includes detailed color metadata used by the enhanced character meshes, confirming Ahmad's kufi-wearing model uses his defined colors, Fatima's hijab-wearing model uses her colors, and Sheikh Omar's turban-wearing model uses his colors. No structural changes to the character definitions are needed, but verify color values are accurately specified for the enhanced rendering.

Update the character preview rendering logic to display the enhanced character models with detailed headwear and clothing geometry, ensuring the preview matches the in-game appearance. The character models should render with the same mesh enhancements applied in GameScene.tsx so players see the polished, culturally appropriate character designs before selection.

requirements.summary: Enhance obstacle and collectible 3D visuals with culturally themed objects, glowing materials, and particle burst effects on collection
acceptanceCriteria: Obstacles have culturally themed shapes with textured or coloured materials
Coins display a gold emissive glow and spin continuously
Special collectibles have a distinct coloured aura distinguishing them from regular coins
A particle sparkle burst plays at the point of collection when the player picks up a coin or collectible

file_operations.description: Replace basic obstacle geometry with culturally themed objects: stone archway barriers using combined box and cylinder geometries arranged in pointed arch shapes, crates with Arabic script textures (use planeGeometry with texture or text decals), ornate pots using cylinder and sphere geometries with decorative ridges. Apply richer materials (MeshStandardMaterial with color, roughness, metalness) to obstacles. For coins, add an emissive gold material (MeshStandardMaterial with emissive: gold) and implement continuous spinning animation via rotation update in the animation loop. For special collectibles (prayer beads, lanterns, Quran scrolls), add distinct glowing auras by wrapping each collectible mesh with a slightly larger semi-transparent sphere using emissive material in a type-specific color (e.g., teal for beads, amber for lanterns, ivory for scrolls).

Implement particle burst effect on coin/collectible collection: create a particle system using InstancedMesh or Points geometry with multiple small sphere particles. When the collision detection triggers a coin or collectible pickup, spawn a burst of golden sparkle particles at the collection point, animate them outward in a radial explosion pattern with upward drift and fade-out over 0.5-1 second, then remove the particles. Integrate this particle spawn into the existing handleCollision or collectible collection logic.

requirements.summary: Improve scene lighting with warm directional sunlight, ambient teal fill, point lights near lanterns/collectibles, and shadow casting
acceptanceCriteria: Directional warm sun light is visible casting directional shading on objects
Ambient teal fill light softens shadow areas
Collectibles and lanterns emit localised warm point light
Ground plane receives shadows from player and nearby objects

file_operations.description: Add a directionalLight with amber/orange color (e.g., color='#FF9955') positioned above and angled down to simulate warm desert sunlight, with castShadow enabled. Add an ambientLight with deep teal color (e.g., color='#226677') at moderate intensity to provide soft fill lighting in shadow areas. Add pointLight instances near lantern props and collectible positions with warm amber/gold color for localised glow effects. Enable shadow receiving on the ground plane mesh (receiveShadow property) and shadow casting on the player character and key architectural props (castShadow property). Ensure the React Three Fiber Canvas has shadows enabled.

requirements.summary: Redesign all UI screens with Islamic geometric backgrounds, Cinzel Decorative headings, glowing gold/terracotta buttons, frosted panels, and consistent desert palette
acceptanceCriteria: All screen headings use Cinzel Decorative font
Buttons have gold/terracotta gradient fills with visible hover glow effect
UI panels use semi-transparent frosted dark backgrounds with geometric border decorations
Islamic geometric pattern motifs appear consistently on all screens as backgrounds or accents
HUD in-game score and coin counter panels have frosted panel styling with geometric accents

file_operations.description: Wrap the main menu content in a layered container with an Islamic geometric pattern background (use the generated islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png tile from frontend/public/assets/generated as a repeating CSS background-image). Apply Cinzel Decorative font to all heading elements. Replace existing button styles with glowing gold/terracotta gradient buttons: add CSS classes with linear-gradient backgrounds (gold to terracotta), add hover effects with box-shadow glow (gold rgba), and add subtle shimmer animation to button borders. Wrap menu panels in semi-transparent frosted containers (backdrop-filter: blur, background: rgba dark with low opacity) with geometric border accents (use SVG or CSS border-image with star/polygon patterns). Ensure consistent use of the desert palette colors (sand-gold, terracotta, deep-teal, ivory) defined in the Tailwind config throughout the screen.

Apply the same visual treatment as MainMenu: add the islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png background tile from frontend/public/assets/generated, use Cinzel Decorative for the screen heading, style character selection cards with semi-transparent frosted panels with geometric border decorations, and apply glowing gold/terracotta gradient button styles to the Start Game button. Ensure character cards use the desert palette and have hover glow effects.

Apply consistent UI redesign: add the islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png background tile from frontend/public/assets/generated, use Cinzel Decorative for the Game Over heading, style the score summary panel and nickname input container with frosted semi-transparent backgrounds and geometric border accents, and update all buttons (Retry, Main Menu, Submit Score) with the glowing gold/terracotta gradient style with hover effects. Ensure the screen uses the desert palette consistently.

Apply consistent UI redesign: add the islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png background tile from frontend/public/assets/generated, use Cinzel Decorative for the Leaderboard heading, style the leaderboard table container with a frosted semi-transparent panel with geometric border decorations, style leaderboard entries with subtle geometric divider lines, and update the Back button with the glowing gold/terracotta gradient style with hover effect. Ensure the screen uses the desert palette consistently.

Redesign HUD elements with frosted panel styling: wrap the score display, coin counter, power-up indicator, shield indicator, and speed meter in semi-transparent frosted dark panels (backdrop-filter: blur, background: rgba with low opacity) with geometric border accents (small star/polygon SVG borders or CSS pseudo-elements). Use Cinzel Decorative font for HUD labels. Apply gold/terracotta color scheme to numeric values and meter fills. Ensure HUD panels have consistent geometric decorative borders that match the UI screen styling.

Add utility classes for the new UI styling: define .btn-gradient-gold for glowing gold/terracotta gradient buttons with hover glow box-shadow, define .panel-frosted for semi-transparent frosted backgrounds with backdrop-filter blur, define .border-geometric for geometric pattern border decorations (using CSS border-image or pseudo-elements with SVG patterns), and define .heading-decorative to ensure Cinzel Decorative font is applied to all headings. Add shimmer animation keyframes for subtle button border animations. Ensure all new utility classes use the desert palette CSS variables (sand-gold, terracotta, deep-teal, ivory).

requirements.summary: Generate and use updated visual assets: hero cityscape background and geometric tile texture
acceptanceCriteria: Main menu renders the hero cityscape background image behind the menu panel
UI screens display the geometric tile texture as a subtle background pattern
Images load from frontend/public/assets/generated

file_operations.description: Wire the generated hero cityscape background image menu-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png from frontend/public/assets/generated/menu-hero-bg.dim_1920x1080.png into the MainMenu screen as a full-screen background layer behind the menu panel. Use CSS background-image with background-size: cover and background-position: center to ensure the Islamic desert cityscape at dusk with minarets, domes, crescent moon, and stars fills the screen. Layer the menu content (buttons, panels) on top with appropriate z-index.

Wire the generated geometric tile texture islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png from frontend/public/assets/generated/islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png as a repeating background pattern (CSS background-image with background-repeat: repeat) behind the character selection content. Ensure the pattern is subtle and does not overpower the character cards.

Wire the generated geometric tile texture islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png from frontend/public/assets/generated/islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png as a repeating background pattern behind the game over content, consistent with other UI screens.

Wire the generated geometric tile texture islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png from frontend/public/assets/generated/islamic-tile-pattern.dim_512x512.png as a repeating background pattern behind the leaderboard content, consistent with other UI screens.
